title: SA attach issue
body:
Hey @acetcom 

I've spent some time studying my SA attach issue, and have narrowed the problem down. It seems to be related to the session context...

Currently running tests with a Qualcomm x55 modem in SA mode. I get exactly the same results with the Huawei Balong 5000 in SA mode.

Fresh compile of git master; commit 22b09443ce41c34786df167916d603bd17771d69. I cleaned out MongoDB and recreated the USIM profiles.

Running all Open5GS components on the Amarisoft gNB computer, so all NFs using the default IP addresses. gNB is on `127.0.1.1`
____

### Clean Restart

- Completely restart the entire core network; ie power cycle all 5GC control plane functions + the UPF.
- Attach gNB
- Attach UE

Result = attach works first time
PCAP and all debug log files = [SA_restartAll.zip](https://github.com/open5gs/open5gs/files/6160460/SA_restartAll.zip)


After this initial successful attach,
* I can powercycle the UE and it reattaches successfully
* I can powercycle the gNB; after it does NGsetup, UE reattaches successfully

____

### Control Plane Restart

- Ok, so this time we assume something has happened with the control plane daemons, and they have restarted
- The UPF remains running (from the above test) - does not get restarted
- After the SMF comes back online, it re- PFCP associates with the UPF
- Attach gNB
- Attach UE

Result = attach fails
PCAP and all debug log files = [SA_restartAll_exceptUPF.zip](https://github.com/open5gs/open5gs/files/6160461/SA_restartAll_exceptUPF.zip)

After the UE sends `UplinkNASTransport`, SMF sends UPF a `PFCP Session Deletion Request` message. UPF responds with session context errors, then the control plane seems to stop doing anything, leading to the gNB timing out after 10 seconds and kicking the UE. The UE then goes into a cycle of failed attach requests.

This is totally repeatable, and occurs with both the Qualcomm and Huawei UEs. 

____

Not sure what you make of this? Is this expected behaviour?

Cheers
Kenny
